escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { EscapeAsterisks = true, EscapeUnderscores = false });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
